notes.title: Discover a new location, neutralize Monsters and get fun in the Fight Club!
notes.content:
In this update we have prepared a lot of new and interesting features for you:
   [*] Discover a new location - the [b]Underworld Docks![/b]
   [*] Make new collections and get new [b]achievements![/b]
   [*] [b] Neutralize Monsters[/b] in the streets more effectively, now that the freezing time can be prolonged!
   [*] Get even more fun from the fighting in the [b]Fight Club![/b]

We strive for constant improvement, so never hesitate to share your feedback. 

Thank you for being a part of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/486460/Twilight_Town/]Twilight Town[/url]!


http://store.steampowered.com/app/486460/Twilight_Town/
